title: Photographs of alien objects on Mars, including a 'square'

tellings.quote: I have probably somewhere in the neighborhood of 60 something photographs of things on Mars that are clearly alien

plain: Mars is covered in objects that are plainly not natural, among them a shape like a square, according to a guest named Joe McMoneagle. He tells Michels he has "somewhere in the neighborhood of 60 something photographs of things on Mars that are clearly alien," which, if true, would mean Mars once had intelligent life.
